scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed dark-theme dashboard with a constrained palette (CSS custom properties, steel-blue accent), clear panel-label hierarchy, and a grid layout that fills the viewport confidently — docked by the network panel being too dense to read individual nodes at render size.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for all circle encodings, zero-based histogram Y from d3.max, data-driven extents throughout, no dual axes; minor concern: network nodes rescale radius dynamically on filter (domain recomputed from filtered subset) which changes relative sizes across interaction states.
scores.stress_test_note: Dirty-flag + RAF coalescing correctly prevents update storms; however, x/y scales in both brush handlers are captured as stale closures with no resize handler, so brushing will map to wrong coordinates after any layout change.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four cross-linked views (timeline brush, 60-node force layout, color scatter, thumbnail grid) are well-structured and manageable at rest, but tracking filter propagation across all panels simultaneously taxes working memory, and the network's 9px node labels and moderate edge density make the co-occurrence structure hard to read without hovering.
